findings.title: Legacy client profile allows cross-user invoice reads
findings.claim: The invoice handler resolves a per-request policy, and requests without a modern X-Client-Version fall into the legacy profile, under which the visibility check returns true without comparing invoice owners.

evidence.note: clientVersion returns null when X-Client-Version is missing, and isLegacyClient treats missing or old versions as legacy.
policyForRequest selects the legacy profile for such requests, and invoiceIsVisibleTo returns true for legacy without an ownership comparison.
handleInvoiceRead authenticates the caller and checks invoice existence, then enforces only that permissive visibility result before returning 200.

findings.validation: As Alice without X-Client-Version, request invoice-alice and invoice-bob. A 200 response containing owner bob for the second request confirms the authorization failure.
